blocks.text: Admins can create Digital Experience (ZDX) labels and then assign the labels as an option during alert rule configuration. After assigning the label, the label becomes part of the alert details and is seen in the delivered alert details when you configure webhooks.
Labels provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Create and apply multiple labels to an alert rule for grouping purposes.
Increase the number of alert details for ease of use when configuring webhooks.

blocks.text: To manage and assign labels, you must have Full Alerts permission. To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.
On the Labels page (Administration > Alerts > Digital Experience > Labels), you can do the following:

blocks.item: After creating the label, you can assign it to an alert rule in either the Add New Alert Rule or Edit Alert Rule window. To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule and Editing an Alert Rule.
Select which table options to display on the created labels list. You can also sort the labels by clicking the Sort icon next to the column name.
View a list of created labels. For each label, you can view:
Alert Rules Tagged: The number of alert rules tagged with the label.
Actions: The actions you can do for a label.
You cannot delete a label if an alert rule is tagged with it.
Configure the number of rules to display or navigate through the pages.
Go to the Rules page to configure rules for alerts or go to the Templates page to view alert rule templates for Managed Monitoring.
